notes.title: Celebrate Summer with us!
notes.content:
Hello Avicii fans, it's been a minute!

Whilst you hydrate (seriously, it's like 2000 degrees out there) and stay cool and safe indoors with your indie games, we thought we'd point your attention to our Summer event which just started! 

We've got some live streams from developers showcasing their latest games, new blogs diving into their development, and some shiny new bundles that just might contain your next favourite indie game

In this case, if you're a fan of Avicii Invector, you can peep at the Action bundle, which contains a host of other pulse pounding games with stunning soundtracks across a range of genres, guaranteed to have you picking up the controller over and over - such as :

- Arcade Paradise
- The Falconeer
- GRIP: Combat Racing
- Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles
- Tiny Troopers: Global Ops
- Tiny Troopers: Joint Ops XL
- Super Dungeon Bros
- Vostok Inc.

Visit The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33134072/sale/wiredsummer2023]Wired Summer Event Page[/url] right now in order to see the latest dev playthroughs of our upcoming titles (and wishlist them!), save money on our bundles, and don't forget to hit the follow button up top to stay up to date with ALL our releases and their latest news!

If you're a fan of socials, you can come hang with us on [url=https://discord.gg/wiredp]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/WiredP]Twitter[/url] too!

notes.title: Arcade Paradise EP Launches for Safe In Our World
notes.content:
Every penny from your purchase goes straight to [url=https://safeinourworld.org/]Safe In Our World.[/url]💰

[url=https://blackrazorrecords.bandcamp.com/releases][h2]GO BUY IT NOW![/h2][/url]

The song is the lead track from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388870/Arcade_Paradise/]Arcade Paradise[/url]. A Game where the protagonist Ashley feels held back, suffocated, and mentally downtrodden. Arcade Paradise is a story that resonates closely with the message of [url=https://safeinourworld.org/]Safe In Our World[/url]. It is an inspirational message of what can be achieved, with help or just with the right motivation… how you CAN rise up against the machine, and how you CAN make your life great.

This is where you come in. We need YOU, the Wired Community to make some noise, Kick down the doors and scream that talking about Mental Health is GOOD!

How can YOU do this? There are lots of ways:

- Buy the single on [url=https://blackrazorrecords.bandcamp.com/releases ]Bandcamp[/url]. (Same price as a meal deal)
- Stream the song for the next week. Let's see if we can hit the charts. Bring on Top of the Pops.
- Share posts, blogs and playlists. The more we share. The more we can diminish the stigma around Mental Health
- Talk to someone and listen. a Simple "How's it going?" can make the world of difference.
- Make sure to tag us in every post, tweet and video. The more we share, the better.

Watch the Official Music Video below

[previewyoutube=GVfC5C5FopU;full][/previewyoutube]

All proceeds from sales of the Arcade Paradise EP from Bandcamp will be donated to the video games mental health charity Safe In Our World, but why did we choose them? Watch below to find out:

A month long celebration of brand new trailers, competitions, sales, a game launch and a couple of announcements along the way! We aren't cruel enough to just tease you like that though, so let's get a quick run down of everything included in the #SummerOfIndieGaming, what we've already done, and what you can look forward to!

notes.title: Avicii Invector: Encore Edition Is Now Out On Meta Quest 2!
notes.content:
Prepare to explore the rhythmic regions of unexplored space in a completely new way! AVICII Invector: Encore Edition is now available on Meta Quest 2!

Watch our brand new launch trailer showing the incredible journey taken by the game that Tim started, and how Quest 2 brings you AVICII's greatest hits in a new dimension!

[previewyoutube=wbUBOOvX1mo;full][/previewyoutube]


In loving memory of Swedish DJ Tim Bergling, most famously known by his professional name, AVICII, Hello There Games and Tim’s father, Klas Bergling, continue Tim’s vision of bringing new ways to experience his music, with AVICII Invector: Encore Edition.

Featuring 35 chart topping tracks such as Peace of Mind, Freak and S.O.S, AVICII Invector brings the futuristic rhythm action gameplay into a VR version for Meta Quest 2 which is available to purchase right now!

[h2]AVICII Invector: Encore Edition Features:[/h2]

⦁ 35 hit anthems from the phenomenal talent of late superstar AVICII.
⦁ SEVEN mesmerising worlds wrapped in a magnificent musical experience viewable in VR.
⦁ Turn up the volume and set yourself a challenge across FOUR complexity levels.
⦁ Lay down your high score and rise up the Global Leaderboards.
⦁ Explore a pure-hearted narrative journey set against the globally celebrated works of AVICII.

As with our releases on other platforms , all music royalties from each copy of the game sold will go to the Tim Bergling Foundation, which advocates for the recognition of suicide as a global health emergency and actively works to remove the stigma attached to suicide and mental health issues.

We'd like to take this moment to thank all of the AVICII fans for their support with Invector from the very beginning, it's a very personal project for us! And whilst we don't know where the journey for Invector ends, we're proud to have had you with us every step of the way!

You can find out more about the Tim Bergling Foundation by visiting: [url=https://www.timberglingfoundation.org/]https://www.timberglingfoundation.org/[/url]

And buy Avicii Invector On Meta Quest 2 by visiting: [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4048766301899067/]https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4048766301899067/[/url]

notes.title: An Update reference our Avicii Switch Lite Charity Raffle
notes.content:
Hey there folks - hope your Friday is treating you all with kindness!

Just wanted to give everyone a quick update reference the charity Ebay auction for the 5th Avicii Switch Lite.

If you bought a raffle ticket (thank you!!) you will have received an email from ebay this morning stating the auction had been removed.

Long story short - our auction was suspended:

Despite working directly with eBay, a separate team, unaware, ended the auction. They have apologised but it is irreversible.

Safe In Our World is going to refund ALL donations. As a small charity with no grants, it is a bit of a pain, but the right thing to do.

In the meantime please sit tight and await your refund - and we are currently setting up a new home to hold the auction.

We will share more soon - thank you for your patience! 💕

notes.title: The smooth update
notes.content:
We have worked hard to make Avicii Invector a faster, smoother and better experience.

Changes and bug fixes: 
[list]
[*] Fixed many of the crash bugs.
[*] Refactored the input system to fix the button prompts. Now correct buttons are displayed for your controller type.
[*] Massive optimizations, making the game run better and have shorter loading pauses.
[*] Smoother menu flow.
[*] Added Turkish localization
[/list]

Please let us know in the steam forums if there's any issues found in this update, its a major one in many ways.

More news coming soon from us at Hello There and Wired Productions!
